articles.title: U.S. SEC's steadiest crypto advocate, Hester Peirce, to depart next week
articles.snippet: The long-anticipated exit of the commissioner sometimes known as Crypto Mom is Oct. 2, announced as the agency was sending out its latest crypto work.

articles.title: Meta's New AI Toy Is a Keychain That Watches, Listens, and Never Blinks
articles.snippet: Muse Charm is Meta's palm-sized gadget for talking to its Muse AI agent on the go. It has cameras, a fingerprint sensor, and its own cell connection.
